title: Inhibitor Masking Device & Sodium Channel, Voltage Gated, Type IX Alpha Subunit (SCN9) Gene Expression
brief_summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of the Inhibitor™ Tinnitus Masking Device. To determine if there is a higher incident of expression of the sodium channel, voltage gated, type IX alpha subunit (SCN9) gene in those subjects with disturbing tinnitus than subjects that are not disturbed by tinnitus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* over 18 years,
* has tinnitus

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pacemaker,
* pregnancy,
* metal implants in head or neck,
* thrombosis, migraines/headaches,
* metal bonded retainer, surgeries within the last 6 months which patient is still recovering from,
* any medical reason your physician would advise against the use of this device,
* under 18 years
